description: Call when a user asks which of two foods is better, healthier or different, or asks you to compare two foods. Send two food names. Foodbe finds both in its stored food data and scores each one on measures such as seasonality, planet, brain, gut and protein. Returns outcome "served" with a verdict naming the winner, one sentence on which food leads on which measure, and a card for each food with its scores. Every field comes from stored data, never from a model, so the same two foods always return the same answer. If either food is not found, or the two names are the same food, it returns outcome "not_found".

item_a.description: The first food, for example salmon.

item_b.description: The second food, for example chicken.

name: foodbe_compare
